Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 2. Generic

1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 4. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TITLE - JOB WORK SERVICE FOR R&D PRODUCT SCALE UP SERVICES IMPORTANT NOTES: ================ The Vendor shall necessarily quote for items with scope, specifications and all other terms & conditions ex actly as stated in HPCL's Tender Enquiry, WITHOUT ANY DEVIATIONS, failing which the offer shall be liable to be rejected. Vendor to submit the following declarations mandatorily along with the bid as per the format attached with the tender document. a) Banned or Delisted or Blacklisted b) Total Acceptance Letter c) Integrity Pact Non submission of the above declarations, vendors offer shall be REJECTED. HPCL’s “General Terms and Conditions of works contract” (GTC) shall be applicable for this co ntract. After placement of the PO, the Rates shall be FIRM during the entire Validity of the Order, WITHOUT ANY es calation whatsoever.

Estimated Basic Financial Limit of this contract is ₹ 55,90,000.00 (Rupees Fifty-five lakh ninety t housand Only). Agency should ensure that the Cumulative Value of items supplied or work / services don e against this order shall not exceed the Financial Limit given above. During the Validity of this contract, depending on its requirements from time to time, HPCL shall issue Ind ents, specifying the Quantities required to be supplied/services to be done. That is, NO Material should be supplied/services to be done against this Rate Contract PO; the Material should be supplied/services to be done ONLY against the Indents / release orders issued subsequently. The contract will be placed in the form of a standing order and HPCL will provide indents/release orders ti me to time as per requirement of product/additive scale up. HPCL shall NOT be bound / obligated to procure any minimum quantity of any Item nor any minimum valu e of material /services and HPCL does not assure nor guarantee availing / consumption of any minimum Fi nancial Limit, from the Vendor on whom the PO is finalized. BRIEF SCOP OF JOB =============== JOB WORK SERVICE FOR R&D PRODUCT SCALE UP SERVICES HPCL will provide the raw materials (different types of chemicals, specialized chemicals, additives, interme diates, polymers, etc., including petroleum products like HSD, SKO, MTO, RPO etc.) required for the produc tion of HPCL products & formulations, along with the following packaging items i.e., barrels, wooden pallets , containers, carboys, metal cap seals. Supervision/ guidance only (excluding the skilled labour, tools/equip ment and infrastructure required, etc.) of the production process, formulation, batch time and fixing the op timum operating conditions to produce good quality of final product, only for the first batch of production f or each product, will be in the scope of HPCL. However, SOP for the same can be reviewed, analysed and modified at any time, as per the HPCL requirements. For detailed scope of job refer Scope of Work (SOW), technical specification document attached to this ten der. (Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document) VALIDITY OF ORDER ================ Two (02) Years from the date mentioned in GeM PO / Contract. JOB TO COMMENCE =============================== The contract will be placed in the form of a standing order and HPCL will provide indents/release orders ti me to time as per requirement of product/additive scale up.

DEFECT LIABILITY PERIOD ===================== 12 months (One year) from the date of manufacturing of the particular batch of the product. Other Details as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE / LIQUIDATED DAMANGES (PRC/ LD) ================================================== Not Applicable. COMPHERENSIVE PERFORMANCE BANK GAURANTEE (BG / CISB)/ RETENTION ========================================================= Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. Quantum: 5% shall be applicable on total contract value. Duration: 2 years. SECURITY DEPOSIT =============== Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. Quantum: 2% shall be applicable on total contract value. BG AGAINST FREE ISSUE MATERIAL =========================== For safekeeping of Raw Materials, Finished Products, Packaging Items, etc., a product security deposit in th e form of Bank Guarantee for an amount of INR 20 lakh has to be deposited to HPCL by the successful bid der. BG in attached format shall be submitted by the successful bidder for the value of ₹ 20,00,000 (Rupees Twenty Lakhs Only). BG shall be valid till date of expiry of contract plus One-month claim period. This shall be considered as security against the materials that shall be issued by HPCL to the vendor from time to time to carry out the jobs as per the scope of the contract. PAYMENT TERMS: ============== 100% payment, based on the completion of job (after acceptance of sample testing result at HPCL Green R &D Centre) as per issued release orders/indents. Payment will be made within thirty (30) days after receip t of the invoice in HPCL’s Vendor portal.

If a sample fails, the entire batch shall be rejected and no payment shall be made. HPCL shall also recover, at actual cost, the value of any fillers, chemicals or raw materials supplied for manufacturing the rejected batch. HPCL’s decision regarding testing, acceptance or rejection shall be final and binding on the bidder. For all other Terms & Conditions, Scope of work, Technical Specifications, Bidders’ Pre-Qualification Criteria etc. refer, ‘Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC’ PRICED BID/HOW TO QUOTE -- ONLINE ONLY: ==================================== This is a Rate Contract with Financial Limit. Bidders to ensure to quote strictly according to the procedure detailed in Buyer Added Bid Specific “AT C Buyer uploaded ATC document” attached in this tender. Please refer Scope of Work (SOW ) document attached in Buyer Added Bid Specific for details of Unit of Measurement to be considered for each line item. GENERAL NOTES & IMPORTANT INFORMATION ===================================== Unless otherwise specified, in case of conflict, HPCL’s General Terms and Condition (HPCL GTC) shall take precedence over GEM’s General Terms and Conditions (GeM GTC). . 6.
